name: Ordrivo Booking Lite
author: ordrivo

sections.description:
Ordrivo Booking Lite gives service businesses a clean, mobile-friendly booking form and a practical terminal for managing upcoming appointments.

Features:

  • Realistic starter services for barber, hair, nail and massage businesses.
  • Customer date and time selection.
  • Double-booking protection.
  • Booking terminal with confirm, complete and cancel actions.
  • Email notification to the site administrator.
  • Responsive design and editable WordPress services.
  • No external service required.

Use the automatically created Book an appointment page or add [ordrivo_booking] to any page.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin ZIP in Plugins > Add New > Upload Plugin.
  2. Activate Ordrivo Booking Lite.
  3. Open the automatically created Book an appointment page.
  4. Manage appointments from Ordrivo Booking > Booking Terminal.
  5. Edit services under Ordrivo Booking > Services.
sections.faq:
Does it require a monthly subscription?

No. The Lite plugin works on your WordPress website without an external subscription.

Can I change the demo services?

Yes. Service titles, descriptions, price and duration are stored as editable WordPress content and custom fields.
